title: Let's Learn English Lesson 36
subtitle: I Can Fix This!
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 36: I Can Fix This! (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Last time on Let's Learn English, Marsha and I invited friends to a dinner party but I shopped with the wrong list. Guests are coming soon. Marsha is worried but I have a plan. Let's see what it is.
dialogue.zh: 上次在 Let's Learn English 裡，瑪莎和我請了朋友來吃晚餐，可我按錯清單買了東西。客人馬上就到。瑪莎很擔心，但我有計劃。我們看看是什麼。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I just need a couple of ingredients. Marsha, please hand me the flour.
dialogue.zh: 我只需要幾樣材料。瑪莎，請把麵粉遞給我。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, where is the flour? It's not in the cabinets.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，麵粉在哪裡？不在櫃子裡。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I put the flour inside the refrigerator.
dialogue.zh: 我把麵粉放進冰箱了。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Why?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It's cold and dry in the refrigerator. See, it says: "Put in a cold, dry place." Okay, now, Marsha, please hand me the eggs.
dialogue.zh: 冰箱裡又冷又幹。看，上面寫著：“放在陰涼乾燥處。”好，現在，瑪莎，請把雞蛋遞給我。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, where are the eggs?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，雞蛋在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: The eggs are inside the cabinet under the sink.
dialogue.zh: 雞蛋在水槽下面的櫃子裡。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, why are the eggs in here?
dialogue.zh: 安娜，雞蛋怎麼會在這兒？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: On the farm, we always put the eggs there. How else can the chickens see them? Okay. You clean the living room. I will make dinner.
dialogue.zh: 在農場，我們總是把雞蛋放那兒。不然雞怎麼看見它們？好。你去打掃客廳。我來做晚餐。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: What are you going to make with these ingredients?
dialogue.zh: 你要用這些材料做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have a plan.
dialogue.zh: 我有計劃。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Okay, the apartment is clean. The kitchen is not. What are you cooking?
dialogue.zh: 好，公寓乾淨了。廚房沒有。你在做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I made my favorite recipe: peanut-butter-banana pancakes!
dialogue.zh: 我做了我最喜歡的食譜：花生醬香蕉煎餅！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: You made breakfast.
dialogue.zh: 你做了早餐。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes! I call it let's-eat-breakfast-for-dinner dinner!
dialogue.zh: 是的！我叫它“晚餐吃早餐”晚餐！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna! Mmm! Hey, this tastes good! Anna, you made it work!
dialogue.zh: 安娜！嗯！嘿，這味道不錯！安娜，你搞定了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That's our guests!
dialogue.zh: 客人到了！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: I'll answer the door.
dialogue.zh: 我去開門。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'll finish here.
dialogue.zh: 我在這兒收尾。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Like I said, sometimes Marsha worries too much. When something goes wrong with your plan, just change the plan! Till next time!
dialogue.zh: 就像我說的，有時候瑪莎擔心太多。計劃出問題時，就換個計劃！下次見！

quiz.prompt: Where does Anna put the flour?

choices: Inside the cabinet under the sink

quiz.prompt: What does Anna cook for dinner?
